title: opt: improve quantized kernels INT8/FP8 + smoothquant + dequant-fusion, scheduling and KV-cache batching
author: Asha Patel
description: This PR introduces a set of coordinated changes to the serving runtime to improve quantized inference performance for INT8 and FP8 workloads and to stabilize interaction with KV-cache and continuous batching. Motivation: customers running quantized variants have reported higher than expected per-token latency and CPU/GPU memory churn on long-running chat sessions. Root causes identified: extra dequant/quant round-trips in the attention path, suboptimal kernel selection for mixed-precision workloads (INT8 vs FP8 fallback), and scheduling that did not prioritize short-sequence interactive requests, which increased tail latency under mixed loads. The change set includes: 1) Dequant-fusion pass: add a device-side fusion that fold dequantization into matrix multiply kernels for attention and FFN paths to remove intermediate buffers and memory copies for common quant layouts. 2) SmoothQuant preprocessing pipeline support: integrate smoothquant scale factors into our loader so quantized weight layout and per-channel scaling are applied at compile-time to reduce runtime re-scaling cost. 3) INT8/FP8 kernel improvements: optimized GEMM kernels that handle INT8->FP16 compute path and FP8 emulation paths with improved vectorization and reduced shared-memory barriers. 4) Kernel selector heuristics: runtime heuristics that choose INT8/FP8/dequant-fused kernels based on sequence-length distribution, KV-cache reuse score, and available scratch memory; includes safe fallbacks to FP16 when numerical stability margin is exceeded. 5) Scheduling tweaks: short-sequence prioritization queue and deadline-aware batching to reduce tail latency for interactive use cases while maintaining throughput. 6) KV-cache-aware batching: batching policy now groups requests to maximize KV cache hits and avoid cache invalidation churn during bursty chat sessions. 7) Autotune flags and regression tests: new autotune knobs to calibrate thresholds per-device and a suite of microbenchmarks and long-running stability tests. Benchmarks: end-to-end throughput improved by 18-27% on a 4xA100 dedicated pool for Llama2-13B-int8-smoothed workloads with 32-token prompt and 512-token generation; median latency for p50 reduced 12%, p95 reduced 22% under mixed short+long workload; memory footprint reduced by ~20% for common KV-cache reuse patterns. See CI perf artifacts for detailed numbers. Backwards compatibility: changes are opt-in via the runtime config flag runtime.quant.experimental_fusion=true and default to disabled for older pinned deployments. Rollout: feature gated on canary for Dedicated and hosted tenants with telemetry to track regressions. The PR includes unit, integration and long-running stability tests, and an upgrade note for Dedicated operators.
commits: Add dequant-fusion device pass and tests
Integrate smoothquant scales into model loader
Optimize INT8/FP8 GEMM kernels and vector paths
Add kernel selector heuristics and autotune config
Implement short-sequence prioritization queue and KV-cache batching policy
Add perf tests and CI artifacts
Docs: runtime flags and rollout notes
review_comments: Diego: Please add a short note describing numerical stability testing for FP8 paths. Response: Added fp8_numerics unit tests and a stability doc section in docs/runtime/quant.md.
Emily: Can we gate the fusion behind an opt-in flag so Dedicated customers can opt out? Response: Yes, added runtime.quant.experimental_fusion with a safe default off for older deployments.

Samir: The new scheduler should avoid starvation when prioritizing short sequences; add fairness counters. Response: Implemented deadline-aware batching and fairness token to ensure long-seq progress.

QA: Long-running stability test flaky on A100; observed occasional OOM during 48h run. Response: Tuned scratch allocator and added a fallback to FP16 for affected code paths; re-ran 72h stability tests successfully.
release_notes: Performance: Improved quantized inference throughput and latency for INT8/FP8 via dequant-fusion and kernel optimizations; Memory: reduced runtime memory footprint for KV-cache heavy workloads; Flags: runtime.quant.experimental_fusion (opt-in) and runtime.quant.autotune thresholds added; Stability: long-running KV-cache stability fixes.
notes_for_ops: Canary rollout recommended. Default off for older pinned deployments. Operators should monitor runtime.quant.fusion_enabled telemetry and p95 latency. If regressions seen, set runtime.quant.experimental_fusion=false and revert via standard rollout.
testing_notes: Added microbenchmarks for GEMM variants, synthetic mixed-length workload tests, and a 72h KV-cache stability run. Perf artifacts uploaded to CI. Monitor numerical drift tolerances in fp8_numerics test.
